preconditions.description: The number of towns n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of monasteries m must be at least 2 and less than the number of towns n.
The list of monasteries must contain m distinct integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, _ in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct towns within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 1000 for _, _, c in roads)
preconditions.description: The length of each road must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum number of unhappy pilgrims and the number of ways to achieve this.
